legacyEmployeeLogs.pageSubtitle: Employee operations uploaded by the legacy POS: adding items, price changes, deletions, cash drawer, returns and payments.
legacyEmployeeLogs.wallClockNotice: All times are store local time (wall-clock time written by the legacy POS, no time-zone conversion). Terminals upload logs in batches, usually 10 to 60 minutes late, so the latest operations may not appear yet.

all.hintPos: All operations uploaded by the new POS (WPF / handheld / iPad)

danger.title: Risky operations
danger.hint: By type: deletes, price changes, discounts, cash drawer, returns — directly change takings or cash
danger.hintPos: Removals, price changes, discounts, manual drawer, refunds/voids, overrides and system operations

abnormal.title: Anomalies
abnormal.hint: By behaviour rule: no-sale drawer, delete after checkout, big discount, burst deletes, repeated reprints, off-hours
abnormal.hintPos: Behaviour rules: no-sale drawer, delete after checkout, big discount, burst removal, repeat reprint, off hours, emergency override

noSaleDrawer.label: No-sale drawer
noSaleDrawer.desc: Manual cash drawer opening with no checkout on the same device within 2 minutes either side.

deleteAfterCheckout.label: Delete after checkout
deleteAfterCheckout.desc: Item deleted within 2 minutes after checkout started, before the next sale, worth at least 10.

bigDiscount.label: Big discount / price cut
bigDiscount.desc: Item or cart discount of 50% or more, or a price cut of 50% or more.

burstDelete.label: Burst deletes
burstDelete.desc: Same staff member deleting items 8 or more times within 10 minutes; one flag per burst.

repeatReprint.label: Repeated reprint
repeatReprint.desc: Same order reprinted 3 or more times in a day; the 3rd reprint is flagged.

offHours.label: Off-hours
offHours.desc: Operations outside 07:00–22:00; the first one per device and period is flagged.

emergencyOverride.label: Emergency override
emergencyOverride.desc: Operations performed under a new-POS emergency override (offline or permission bypass); every one needs review.

evidence.noSaleWindow: No checkout on this device within {{seconds}}s
evidence.deleteAfterCheckout: Deleted {{seconds}}s after checkout started at {{at}}, amount {{amount}}
evidence.repeatReprint: Order {{order}} reprinted {{count}} times today, first at {{first}}
evidence.deleteAfterTender: Removed {{seconds}}s after payment started at {{at}}, amount {{amount}}
evidence.repeatReprintDay: Reprinted {{count}} times on this device today, first at {{first}}

employees.hint: Sorted by anomalies and risky share · open a staff member to see their records
employees.footnote: Takings reduced = deletes, price changes, cart discounts and no-receipt returns; same store, time and device filters as above.
employees.empty: No staff operations in this range
employees.footnotePos: Amount = total reduction from removals, cart clears, price changes, discounts and refunds (successful operations only), using the store, time, device and keyword filters above.

review.title: Review
review.notePlaceholder: e.g. checked CCTV, customer returned the item
review.conflict: Someone just reviewed or changed this record; refreshed to the latest state
review.readOnly: You can view the review result but cannot review

legacyEmployeeLogs.dangerOnly: Risky operation: changes takings or cash directly; no anomaly rule matched.

rulesPos.noSaleDrawer: Manual drawer open (no order) with no completed sale or refund on the same device within 2 minutes.
rulesPos.deleteAfterCheckout: For the new POS, checkout starts when payment starts: item removed, cart cleared or quantity reduced after payment started and before the sale completed, reducing the total by ≥ 10.
rulesPos.bigDiscount: Item or order discount ≥ 50%, or price cut ≥ 50%, saving ≥ 10 (small one-tap 50% discounts are ignored).
rulesPos.burstDelete: Same cashier removed ≥ 8 items within 10 minutes; one flag per burst.
rulesPos.repeatReprint: Same receipt reprinted ≥ 3 times (grouped by the previous sale on the device); flags the 3rd.
rulesPos.offHours: Operations outside 07:00–22:00 store local time; first one per device and period.
rulesPos.emergencyOverride: Operations performed under a new-POS emergency override (offline or permission bypass); every one needs review.
